title: Two Linked Sequences
statement:
Sequences of real numbers $x_1, x_2, x_3, \dots$ and $y_1, y_2, y_3, \dots$ satisfy $x_1 = 3$, $y_1 = 7$ and, for every positive integer $n$,
$$x_{n+1}^2 + y_{n+1}^2 + x_n^2 + y_n^2 = 2x_n y_{n+1} - 2x_{n+1} y_n.$$
Find the value of $$\sum_{n=1}^{2026} n \cdot x_n.$$
hints: Move every term of the relation to one side. Then look at how the terms pair up: $x_{n+1}^2$, $y_n^2$ and $2x_{n+1}y_n$ belong together, and so do $y_{n+1}^2$, $x_n^2$ and $-2x_n y_{n+1}$.

Use a sum of squares. The rearranged relation says that two perfect squares add up to $0$, and for real numbers this forces each square to be $0$. This gives simple formulas for $x_{n+1}$ and $y_{n+1}$ in terms of $x_n$ and $y_n$.

The relation becomes $(x_{n+1} + y_n)^2 + (y_{n+1} - x_n)^2 = 0$, so $x_{n+1} = -y_n$ and $y_{n+1} = x_n$. The $x_n$ therefore repeat as $3, -7, -3, 7, \dots$. Each block of four consecutive terms of the sum, starting from $n = 1$, equals $8$, and $2026 = 4 \cdot 506 + 2$, so two terms are left over.
solution: Moving every term to the left-hand side and grouping gives $$\left(x_{n+1}^2 + 2x_{n+1} y_n + y_n^2\right) + \left(y_{n+1}^2 - 2x_n y_{n+1} + x_n^2\right) = 0,$$ which is $$(x_{n+1} + y_n)^2 + (y_{n+1} - x_n)^2 = 0.$$ The square of a real number is never negative, so two such squares can add up to $0$ only if both are $0$. Hence $x_{n+1} = -y_n$ and $y_{n+1} = x_n$ for every positive integer $n$. Combining these gives $x_{n+2} = -y_{n+1} = -x_n$, and applying this twice gives $x_{n+4} = x_n$. We have $x_1 = 3$ and $x_2 = -y_1 = -7$, and then $x_3 = -x_1 = -3$ and $x_4 = -x_2 = 7$. So the sequence $x_n$ repeats $3, -7, -3, 7$ with period $4$. Now group the sum into blocks of four. For any integer $k \ge 0$, the terms with $n = 4k + 1, 4k + 2, 4k + 3, 4k + 4$ add up to $$3(4k + 1) - 7(4k + 2) - 3(4k + 3) + 7(4k + 4) = 3 \cdot (-2) + 7 \cdot 2 = 8.$$ Since $2026 = 4 \cdot 506 + 2$, the blocks with $k = 0, 1, \dots, 505$ cover $n = 1$ to $2024$ and contribute $506 \cdot 8 = 4048$. The two remaining terms have $n = 2025$ and $n = 2026$. These leave remainders $1$ and $2$ on division by $4$, so $x_{2025} = 3$ and $x_{2026} = -7$. They contribute $2025 \cdot 3 - 2026 \cdot 7 = 6075 - 14182 = -8107$. The sum is therefore $4048 - 8107$, and the answer is $-4059$. Why this works. sos, periodicity, block-grouping-of-sums: writing the relation as a sum of squares turns one equation into two linear recurrences, whose period $4$ makes every block of four terms contribute the same constant.
